correctness.rationale: Automorphisms are exactly pairs (A,u) with A in GL_2(F_q) and u a linear functional; the top exterior generator scales by det(A). The fixed equations are (A-I)v=0 and u(v)+(det(A)-1)t=0. The determinant-not-one, identity, nonidentity-unipotent, and remaining determinant-one strata exhaust GL_2 and yield the four displayed multiplicities. The formulas sum to the exact automorphism-group order, the Burnside weighted sum is 3q, and exhaustive checks for q=3,5,7 agree exactly.

value.rationale: The fixed-space spectrum is a natural finite-field statistic of a classical algebra and refines the structural automorphism-group description. It is complete for rank two, uniform over all odd finite fields, and has a direct Burnside interpretation: exactly three radical orbit types occur for each scalar part. This is a coherent structural classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice or a numerical recomputation.
